<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Enrolls the remaining Kernels jobs in `automatic_shard`: 30 jobs (18 steps and 12 AMD mirrors). Part of a series that enrolls every remaining test step, split by test area for review. Commands change only where noted below.

## Claims

| Step | Plan | AMD mirror |
|---|---|---|
| `kernels-fp8-moe-test-1xh100` | 1 shard | none |
| `kernels-mhc-test-b200` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `kernels-minimax-m3-attention-b200` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `kernels-fla-ops-test-b200` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `deepseek-v4-kernel-test-b200` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `kernels-fp4-moe-test-b200` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `kernels-flashmla-test-h100` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `kernels-minimax-reduce-rms-test-2-gpus` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `vllm-ir-tests` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `kernels-gate-linear-cutedsl-b200` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `kernels-bf16x3-router-gemm-h100` | 1 shard | none |
| `kernels-attention-diffkv-test-h100` | 1 shard | 1 shard |
| `minimax-m3-model-tests-b200` | 1 shard | none |
| `kernels-minimax-m3-sparse-prefill-h100` | 1 shard | none |
| `minimax-m3-mega-moe-test-b200` | 1 shard | none |
| `amd-fp8-moe-kernels-mi355` | 1 shard | none |
| `amd-native-quantization-kernels-mi355` | 1 shard | none |
| `amd-kernels-mi355` | 1 shard | none |
| `kernels-b200` | already enrolled | 1 shard |
| `kernels-fusedmoe-layer-test-2-b200s` | already enrolled | 1 shard |

- One-shard and one-job plans run the same tests as on main, as one job, and split by themselves once their tests grow.


## Validation

- Planned each step and mirror with ci-infra main's planner against main's timings; every plan is within 10% of the same plan run as one job.
- The sharding harness (each shard's commands run against a mock test tree, as a PR build and as main with the OTel wrapper) shows every test runs exactly once wherever a plan has 2 or more shards.
- Every step and mirror passes on recent main runs, nightly included.
- `/ci run` (98456, and 98510 on this head) plus a scoped build (98467) for the optional steps and AMD mirrors: every enrolled job passed, and every shard finished under 22 minutes.

## Details

- **DeepSeek V4 Kernels (B200)** names the one file its glob matched (`test_fused_deepseek_v4_qnorm_rope_kv_insert.py`), as #64355 did for the H100 step: the planner reads the files a command names and doesn't expand shell globs.
- **Not plain pytest** steps (shell scripts, `torchrun`, examples) are enrolled too; the generator keeps them as one job. Standalone AMD steps plan like any other since vllm-project/ci-infra#871.
- **caplog.** Files that assert on logs sit in one-shard plans here, so their order in the process doesn't change.
- **Timeouts unchanged.** `timeout_in_minutes` stays per job. Fallback-aware timeouts belong in a central timeout setting.
